newsitem.title: UK: Clyde shares active, Gulf Canada buys.
newsitem.headline: Clyde shares active, Gulf Canada buys.

text.p: Shares in Clyde Petroleum Plc were the most heavily traded on London's stock exchange on Tuesday as hostile bidder Gulf Canada Resources Ltd bought up stock, dealers said.
Volume was more than 82 million by 1428 GMT.
Clyde's share price was unchanged at 120p.
Dealers said Cazenove had been buying Clyde shares on behalf of Gulf Canada. "Cazenove have been hoovering up shares," one said.
Gulf Canada said its holding in Clyde on Monday was 29.4 million shares, or 7.14 percent.
A spokesman for Gulf Canada said the company would be making a statement later in the day.
Gulf bid for Scottish exploration and production company Clyde in December and raised its offer to 120 pence per share last week. The offer closes on February 18.
Clyde has rejected Gulf Canada's offer, calling it inadequate.
Fund manager CIN management said it had sold around 13 million Clyde shares on Tuesday.
